#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Senior Software Engineer in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
In this role, you will build scalable web solutions that drive Infineon's technology road mapping. You will work in a collaborative environment where modern software development and DevOps practices come together.
Design and build maintainable, scalable solutions, applying sound engineering judgment and making pragmatic technical decisions
Collaborate with other developers, architects, business analysts, UX experts and business stakeholders to design and build efficient, effective and scalable systems
Guide and support other engineers through mentoring, code reviews, knowledge sharing and technical discussions
Design and implement automation tools and frameworks for CI/CD, test automation and deployment
Work in cross-functional Scrum teams and follow DevOps practices and methods
Take end-to-end ownership of solutions, from understanding the problem and shaping the design to implementation, testing, deployment and operation
Continuously explore and evaluate new engineering practices and technologies, including AI-assisted software development, and turn useful approaches into practical improvements for the team
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 You bring an adaptable engineering mindset, continuously learning, experimenting pragmatically, constructively challenging ideas and looking for better ways to build and deliver software. We value strong engineering fundamentals, technical judgment and the ability to learn and adapt alongside relevant experience with our technology stack.
University degree in Computer Science, Informatics or in a related field 
3+ years of strong hands-on experience in software development with .NET technologies, including designing and integrating maintainable software systems and making sound technical trade-offs
Strong experience building modern web applications with .NET and a good working knowledge of front-end technologies and relational databases. Experience with our technology stack (e.g. Angular, React, TypeScript and Microsoft SQL) is beneficial
Good understanding of modern software delivery practices, including version control, CI/CD and automation. Experience with tools such as Git, GitLab CI or Jenkins is beneficial
Experience with cloud-native development, containerization and deployment environments; familiarity with Kubernetes or OpenShift is beneficial
Experience with agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, test automation) 
Fluency in English (mandatory)
 Please send us your CV in English.
 #WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
